description: Turn automatic replies (out of office) on, off or scheduled, and set their text and who outside the organization gets one. Only what you pass changes; the confirmation shows the exact text that will go out, including stored text you did not replace. Read the current setting with outlook_get_mailbox_settings. The status is verified by re-reading it. If Outlook does not answer in time, the connection drops, or a server error (5xx) comes back after the request was sent, the result has status "unknown": the write may well have gone through, so check before retrying — never resend blindly. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

externalAudience.description: Who outside your organization gets a reply

externalMessage.description: Reply sent outside your organization (text or HTML)

internalMessage.description: Reply sent inside your organization (text or HTML)

timeZone.description: Windows time-zone name. Defaults to the MAILBOX time zone.

name: outlook_set_auto_reply
